name: Buffered Kinesis
body:
Prerequisite(s): Advanced kinesis wild talent or Kinetic Invocation, internal buffer class feature.

Benefit(s): When you use a spell-like ability with advanced kinesis or Kinetic Invocation, you can spend any number of points from your internal buffer (up to its total cost) to avoid accepting an equal amount of burn.

Normal: You can spend no more than 1 point from your internal buffer on a single wild talent.
